info.title: Vook API
info.description:
Public transcription API. Authenticate every request with your API key: `Authorization: Bearer vk_live_…`.

## Transcribe a file (3 calls)

1. **`POST /api/v1/uploads/init`** → returns an `upload_url`, an `upload_token` and the token's `expires_at`.
2. **`POST {upload_url}`**: POST the whole file to the `upload_url` returned by call 1 (**a different host from this API**) as `multipart/form-data` with a single `chunk` field, authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer {upload_token}`. The file is sent as a single chunk; no chunk index/count is needed. This step is on the ingress service and is not listed below.
3. **`POST /api/v1/transcription-jobs`**: pass the `upload_token` + `file_name` + `language` + `diarize`. Returns a job `id`.

Then **poll `GET /api/v1/transcription-jobs/{id}`** until `status` is `completed` (or `failed`). Read the `transcription_id` through **`GET /api/v1/transcriptions/{id}`** and its `/transcript` / `/export` sub-resources.

bearer.description: Your Vook API key (mint one from the web app).

language.description: Spoken language code, when known. With 'auto', reads 'auto' until processing ends, then the detected code.

folder.description: Folder the transcription belongs to, if any

data.description: The list of items for the current page

language.description: Spoken language code, when known. With 'auto', reads 'auto' until processing ends, then the detected code.

has_transcription.description: Whether the transcript is available to fetch/export

speaker_count.description: Number of detected speakers, when diarized

folder.description: Folder the transcription belongs to, if any

start_time_seconds.description: Start time of this segment in seconds

end_time_seconds.description: End time of this segment in seconds

speaker_key.description: Speaker key, present when diarization was requested

start_time_seconds.description: Start time of the paragraph block in seconds

plain_text.description: Plain text version of the transcript (null when not ready)
plain_text.example: Hello world. This is a transcription.

transcription.description: Structured transcript paragraphs (null when not ready)

word_count.description: Total word count of the transcript

upload_token.description: Upload token returned by POST /api/v1/uploads/init. Send either upload_token or url.

url.description: Direct https link to an audio or video file, such as a presigned object URL. We fetch it for you. Send either upload_token or url.

file_name.description: Original file name. Required with upload_token, optional with url.

language.description: Spoken language code, such as 'en' or 'fr'. Send 'auto' to let us detect it; the transcription then reports the detected code.

name.description: Display name for the resulting transcription(s)

callback_url.description: Webhook endpoint notified once, when the job reaches a terminal status. Public https, standard port. Omit it to poll instead.

language.description: Language code as requested. Reads 'auto' when detection was requested; the transcription carries the detected code.

updated_at.description: When the job was last updated

data.description: The list of items for the current page

language.description: Language code as requested. Reads 'auto' when detection was requested; the transcription carries the detected code.

transcription_id.description: ID of the transcription this job produced. Read it via GET /api/v1/transcriptions/:id. Null until the job reaches `processing`.

callback_url.description: The endpoint this job notifies when it resolves, as submitted. Null when the job was submitted without one.

error_code.description: Failure code when the job failed

updated_at.description: When the job was last updated

title.description: Short label for the chat, shown when you list chats

prompt.description: Question or instruction to run against the transcript
prompt.example: List the action items decided in this meeting.

content.example: List the action items decided in this meeting.

transcription_id.description: ID of the transcription this chat runs against

turn_in_progress.description: True while a message on this chat is being answered. Poll the chat until it is false: your prompt and its answer in messages means the turn completed.

prompt.description: Question or instruction to run against the transcript
prompt.example: List the action items decided in this meeting.

transcription_id.description: ID of the transcription this chat runs against

data.description: Chats for the transcription, including chats opened in the web app

callback_url.description: Candidate webhook endpoint. Public https, standard port.

status_code.description: HTTP status the endpoint answered, null on a transport error

error.description: Transport error, null when the endpoint answered

upload_url.description: Absolute URL to POST the file to, as `multipart/form-data` with a single `chunk` field. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <upload_token>`. This is a different host from the API. Always use the value returned here rather than hardcoding it.

upload_token.description: Short-lived token scoped to this upload session. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <upload_token>` to `upload_url` with the file, then pass it again when you create the transcription job.

expires_at.description: When the upload token expires. Start the upload before this instant; an upload already in flight is not interrupted.
